duplicates_merged: Bam Knight / Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI): nickname variant canonicalised to the Sleeper name Zonovan Knight.
Chig / Chigoziem Okonkwo (TE, WAS): first-name variants merged via the canonical-first-name map.

Source names are HTML-unescaped and accent-stripped before normalisation, which prevents apostrophe players (Ka'imi Fairbairn, Ja'Marr Chase, De'Von Achane, J'Mari Taylor) splitting into duplicate entries.
position_conflicts_resolved: Travis Hunter: Sleeper lists him at DB; sources rank him at WR, so he is filed at WR by source majority with his Sleeper id (12530) preserved for the notes join.
Kyle Juszczyk and Hunter Luepke: fullbacks that some sources list at RB; Sleeper FB is mapped to RB, so they remain at RB and are flagged as non-assets in their outlooks.
Canonical position is taken from Sleeper where the Sleeper position is one of QB/RB/WR/TE/K; otherwise the majority of sources decides.
team_abbrev_fixed: JAC->JAX, WSH->WAS, LA->LAR normalised before keying defences, so no phantom duplicate DST.
Defence names are written as the Sleeper first_name + last_name form (e.g. 'Houston Texans') so they join against the app's Sleeper and FantasyCalc name keys.
notes: All source ranks were retrieved on 2026-09-07; no source was carried forward from the previous file.
CBS Sports was dropped this run: its per-position ranking pages returned no player table (client-rendered / bot-gated), so it could not be verified.

Yahoo Sports added via the public pub-api-ro fantasy endpoint (O-Rank, Yahoo default scoring rather than strict full PPR) and FTN Fantasy added from its top-115 overall list; FTN is shallow, so many players show no ftn rank.
FantasyPros dynasty ranks are kept as a separate source for the two superflex dynasty leagues; NBC/Rotoworld covers only its top 200 and FTN only 115, so depth players legitimately show n<7.
